label: Selected-world CONCRETE_6 from weak calibration and named elimination (inference)
rule: Apply the restricted structural fork and eliminate each covered countercase
meaning: Keep the same supplied causal frame, power and concreteness predicates. The fork either supplies the owner condition or a selected countercase. Named coverage takes that countercase to a named one, and named failure excludes each of the three cases. The one-direction calibration is used in the structural fork. The grounds field has no role.
